preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of roads m is at least n - 1, ensuring the graph is connected.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui for vi, ui in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range from 1 to n.
The number of road pairs in the input matches the specified number of roads m.

postconditions.description: The output is a floating-point number.
The average number of safe roads is between 0 and n - 1 inclusive.
The output is within 1e-6 of the maximum possible average number of safe roads.
